Name: Joja Builds Pam's House - Joja Community Upgrade
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
I’m always thinking of ways to make the Joja route feel more Joja-centered, and eventually I looked at Pam’s house and thought, ‘How could Joja take advantage of this?’ So here we are. 

[color=#6d9eeb][i][b][size=4]Joja Community Upgrades![/size][/b][/i][i] ™[/i][/color]

This mod gives Pam’s upgraded house a full makeover for Joja members.[i][size=1] (Terms and conditions apply).[/size][/i]

Features:
[list]
[*]Changes the exterior and interior of Pam’s upgraded house to reflect a new Joja sponsorship. Seasonal variations included.[/*]
[*]Rewrites Pam’s Community Upgrade cutscene with a new Joja-centered storyline.[/*]
[*]Adds a super cool and fully functional Joja Cola vending machine (actually built into the structural integrity of the house.)[/*]
[*]Doesn’t change how the Community Upgrade works. You’ll still purchase it from Robin at the normal cost.[/*]
[*]Only triggers if you're a Joja member.[/*]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. Not compatible with other mods that modify Pam's house. [/*]
[/list]
Install now so Pam and Penny can THRIVE. 💙
